page: UpCloud GPU-48xCPU-480GB-2xB200 is an x86_64 architecture server running on the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon 8570 processor with 48 physical cores and 48 vCPUs at a base clock speed of 2.0 GHz. The CPU allocation is shared. The system is equipped with 480.0 GB of system memory, providing 10.0 GB per core. Acceleration is driven by two NVIDIA Blackwell B200 GPUs with a combined VRAM of 384 GB. Local storage is not included on this instance.

Benchmark data shows top-tier multi-core and memory performance. The PassMark CPU score of 88,533.65 and extended instructions test score of 132,359.27 both rank in the top 10% tier. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression reached 706.88 GB/sec, also in the top tier. Large-block read-only memory bandwidth is measured at 385.14 GB/sec, while write bandwidth is 134.73 GB/sec. Single-core performance is moderate, with a stress-ng single-core score of 2,168.19 falling into the average category.

The processor supports advanced instruction sets including Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX_TILE, AMX_INT8) and Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX-512), which accelerate matrix operations and cryptography. For LLM inference using a small 135M model, prompt processing reached 9,458.91 tokens/sec and text generation reached 317.76 tokens/sec. A key architectural tradeoff is the shared CPU allocation and the complete absence of local storage, requiring external storage solutions for persistent data.

Given the high density of GPU memory and system memory relative to the 48 shared vCPUs, this server offers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-bound and GPU-accelerated workloads rather than raw single-core CPU-bound tasks. It is designed for large-scale machine learning inference, data science pipelines, deep learning training, and database operations, as evidenced by its top-tier PassMark database score of 33,288.64.
description: UpCloud GPU-48xCPU-480GB-2xB200 is an x86_64 GPU-accelerated server utilizing the KVM hypervisor. It is configured with an Intel Xeon 8570 processor featuring 48 physical cores, 48 vCPUs with shared allocation, and 480.0 GB of system memory. Graphics and parallel processing acceleration are delivered by two NVIDIA Blackwell B200 GPUs providing a total of 384 GB VRAM. The server lacks local storage. In benchmark testing, it demonstrates top-tier performance in multi-threaded operations, large-block memory read bandwidth at 385.14 GB/sec, and PassMark database operations. It also achieves top-tier prompt processing speeds of 9,458.91 tokens/sec for small LLM inference. This hardware profile is optimized for deep learning, large-scale AI inference, complex database operations, and memory-intensive parallel computing workloads.
